question: Which of the following diatomic molecules has the lowest binding energy ?:
analysis: In the context of diatomic molecules, the molecule with the lowest binding energy would be the one with the weakest bond. The strength of a bond is inversely related to the bond length and directly related to the bond dissociation energy. Among the options provided, the bond in H2 is the weakest due to the larger atomic size of hydrogen atoms compared to the other elements. This results in a longer bond length and lower binding energy.
